title: Conductor: dynamic work routing advisor for hub
description: New hub advisor that routes work to the right agent/model/provider dynamically. Sits above the Wheel Council (Gardener/Spinner/Compass). Chooses model tier (Haiku/Sonnet/Opus/local LLM), provider (Claude Max, other providers), and dispatches to the appropriate spoke or hub session. User has Claude Max and multiple providers — effective routing across these is the multiplier.

perceive.current_state: Work routing is implicit — model_fit field in lugs suggests tier, but no automated dispatch. Tender uses Haiku. Human sessions use whatever model is active. No cross-provider routing. No cost awareness.

steps: 1. Design Conductor advisor architecture (how it reads lug model_fit, provider availability, cost)
2. Define routing rules: Haiku for extraction/health, Sonnet for implementation, Opus for architecture
3. Implement provider registry (Claude Max, local LLM endpoints, API keys)
4. Build dispatch mechanism (how Conductor triggers a session on a specific provider)
5. Wire into Ozi: when Ozi decides work should happen, Conductor decides WHERE

done_when: Conductor can route a lug to Haiku, Sonnet, or Opus based on model_fit
Ozi delegates to Conductor for provider selection

acceptance_criteria: Automated model/provider routing for lug execution
Works with Claude Max + at least one other provider
